title: Answer: no position on free will, consciousness is a real cause

statements.text: The papers drawn on here take no position on free will. On agency they aim to keep human consciousness causally efficacious: on constitutive panpsychism a feeling of pain causes the scream because it consists in the micro-level cause.

sources.quote: Mental causation is the thesis that human consciousness causes things to happen.
The constitutive panpsychist avoids this worry, as the causally efficacy of grounded facts are not 'crowded out' by the causal efficacy of their grounds.
